root_cause.text: The igc driver configured an oversized TX packet buffer (7KB per queue) for TSN mode, exceeding the I225/I226 hardware-recommended limit and causing TX unit hangs under heavy timestamping load.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states that "The previous 7 KB per queue caused TX unit hangs under heavy timestamping load" and that the fix reduces it to 5KB "to match the TSN recommendation in I225/I226 SW User Manual Section 7.5.4." The patch changes `IGC_TXPBSIZE_TSN` from `IGC_TXPB0SIZE(7) | IGC_TXPB1SIZE(7) | IGC_TXPB2SIZE(7) | IGC_TXPB3SIZE(7)` to `IGC_TXPB0SIZE(5) | IGC_TXPB1SIZE(5) | IGC_TXPB2SIZE(5) | IGC_TXPB3SIZE(5)`.
